confucius.oneLineZh: 以仁与忠恕贯通人伦，用礼乐与正名把君子修身接到德治秩序。
confucius.oneLineEn: Joins ren and reciprocity to human relations; ritual and name-correction link junzi cultivation to virtue-rule.

laozi.oneLineZh: 以无名之道说明生成根据，用无为少欲减少强制并暴露名言限度。
laozi.oneLineEn: Explains generation by the nameless Dao; wuwei and few desires reduce coercion and expose limits of fixed names.

zhuangzi.oneLineZh: 以逍遥无待求精神自由，用齐物与心斋松动是非名言与生死执著。
zhuangzi.oneLineEn: Seeks free wandering without dependence; equalizing things and mind-fasting loosen rigid speech and death-fixation.

plato.oneLineZh: 以理念与洞穴喻区分意见与知识，用灵魂三分与城邦正义互证秩序。
plato.oneLineEn: Separates opinion from knowledge via Forms and the cave; tripartite soul and civic justice mirror each other as order.

aristotle.oneLineZh: 以实体与四因解释事物，用中道与实践智慧把幸福定为合德的理性活动。
aristotle.oneLineEn: Explains things by substance and four causes; mean and practical wisdom cast flourishing as virtuous rational activity.

kant.oneLineZh: 以先验形式说明经验知识何以可能，用定言命令与自律重设道德与自由。
kant.oneLineEn: Shows how experience is possible via a priori forms; categorical imperative and autonomy reset morality and freedom.

rawls.oneLineZh: 以原初状态与无知之幕选择正义原则，用差异原则与公共理性协调自由平等。
rawls.oneLineEn: Uses veil of ignorance to pick justice principles; difference principle and public reason balance liberty and equality.

wollstonecraft.oneLineZh: 以女性理性可教论证公民平等，并延伸权利语言批判卢梭式性别教育。
wollstonecraft.oneLineEn: Argues civic equality from women's trainable reason and extends rights-language against Rousseau-style gender education.

freire.oneLineZh: 以银行式教育批判揭示压迫再生产，用对话与意识化把教育写成解放实践。
freire.oneLineEn: Shows how banking education reproduces oppression; dialogue and conscientization cast pedagogy as liberatory practice.
